758:t_1:1186.en:
$$ミサコ#pilot$$
「You're the one I should be asking, $$マキ#pilot$$. Are you all right? I heard the war left you with memory problems...」

758:t_1:1187.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「Thank you, $$ミサコ#pilot$$. But I can't afford to show weakness.」

758:t_1:1188.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「Not with things the way they are. I'll do what I can as a nurse, too.」

758:t_1:1189.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
(But what is this...? This pain left deep in my heart...)

758:t_1:1190.en:
$n
($$シンヤ#pilot$$, $$ミサコ#pilot$$... You don't need to worry anymore...)

758:t_1:1191.en:
$n
(Goodbye, $$マキ#pilot$$... Please look after the two of them...)

759:t_000:0.en:
$$トライア$$
「Well then, $n... I'm handing over all control of the $$ソーラリアン$$ to you.」

759:t_000:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「But are you really sure about this? Without a $$Ｚクリスタル$$, there's only so much this thing can do.」

759:t_000:3.en:
$n
「The $$ジェニオン$$ and the $$スフィア$$s were both lost in that battle, after all.」

759:t_000:4.en:
$n
「For my journey from now on, I'll be using this $$ソーラリアン$$.」

759:t_000:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Adventuring across parallel worlds as a Gate traveler, all on your own, huh... That's one hell of a big dream.」

759:t_000:6.en:
$$エスター$$
「But are you really sure you want to go alone...?」

759:t_000:8.en:
$$トライア$$
「In that case, here's a present for your send-off. Go look at the monitor in the hangar.」

759:t_001:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「I repaired it as much as I could. Use it on your journey.」

759:t_001:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Looks like your guides have arrived, too.」

759:t_002:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「Though $c was disbanded once the spacetime repairs were complete.」

759:t_002:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But with this Gate set up in the waters near Earth, travel between parallel worlds is possible.」

759:t_002:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「The world went back to normal, but this way we can still meet again like this.」

759:t_002:4.en:
$n
「So that's our new world... the hyperdimensional world...」

759:t_002:5.en:
$$葵$$
「So, as part of the trial run, we came to see you off.」

759:t_002:7.en:
$$シン$$
「$n... Did you cut your hair?」

759:t_002:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「It doesn't look any different, though...」

759:t_002:10.en:
$n
「I trimmed three centimeters off the damaged ends.」

759:t_002:12.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$n! If you're going to travel the parallel worlds, we'll be your guides for the time being!」

759:t_002:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You never know what will happen with a Gate that's only just started operating.」

759:t_002:15.en:
$$キラ$$
「Can you really run the $$ソーラリアン$$ by yourself, without $$ＡＧ$$?」

759:t_002:16.en:
$n
「I had Dr. $$トライア$$ modify it for that.」

759:t_002:17.en:
???
「...But you'll need a navigator, won't you?」

759:t_002:19.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't 'Miss $$スズネ$$' me. You decided to travel the parallel worlds without consulting me or even getting in touch.」

759:t_002:20.en:
$n
「Uh... well... I thought I'd go visit the worlds of everyone in $c...」

759:t_002:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「I can see right through your plans, $n.」

759:t_002:22.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So that's why Class 3-4 at $$陣代高校$$, all of us together, helped out Miss $$スズネ$$.」

759:t_002:23.en:
$n
「But Miss $$スズネ$$... you have your dream of graduating from college and becoming a teacher...」

759:t_002:24.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I can't just leave such a poor student alone.」

759:t_002:26.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm coming with you. Broadening my horizons is necessary for becoming a teacher.」

759:t_002:27.en:
$$ニア$$
「Then Miss $$スズネ$$ is going on a honeymoon, too.」

759:t_002:28.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Thank you. I hope you and $$シモン$$ are happy together, too, $$ニア$$.」

759:t_002:30.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't make a woman say anything more embarrassing than that. Let's go.」

759:t_002:32.en:
$$クロウ$$
「See you, $n! Say hi to $$ランド$$, $$セツコ$$, and everyone for me!」

759:t_002:33.en:
$$エスター$$
「Make sure you come back! Together with Miss $$スズネ$$!」

759:t_003:1.en:
$n
(Dad, Mom, Sis... Everyone in $c, $$ＡＧ$$... I'm off.)

759:t_003:2.en:
$n
(The many worlds we protected... I'm going to see this hyperdimensional world with my own eyes.)
